kai: quick heads-up: users reported transient p50 spikes in us-west2 after we created dedicated carveouts. digging in, looks like carveouts ended up sharing PCIe root with noisy tenants (same root path), so root-level bandwidth still saturated.

miranda: ouch. do we have a node-level inventory of PCIe topology? last I checked we only have rack/slot labels.

oscar: we don't. proposal: run a lightweight discovery (ssh+lspci) to derive a `pcie_root_id` tag per GPU, push to inventory, and add a `--check-root` preflight to `fleetctl carveout`. Can canary on rack09.

infra-bot: INCIDENT-LOG: elevated pcie_stalls on us-west2-rack09 at 2026-03-26T04:12Z, avg util 88% (10m).

paul: agree. small notes: 1) discovery must be read-only and idempotent, 2) tags TTL short (7d) to avoid stale topology after firmware/cabling changes, 3) scheduler cache TTL ~15s to keep alloc latency low.

kai: sketch commands for canary:
```
ansible-playbook playbooks/discover_pcie_root.yml --limit=rack09-host[01..04]
inventoryctl tag push --source=discover-v1 --ttl=7d --hosts=rack09-host[01..04]
# carveout with preflight
fleetctl carveout create --tenant=t-recs --cards=1 --region=us-west2 --check-root
```
miranda: add a placement probe: after carveout creation, run `lspci -tv` on allocated hosts to confirm unique root paths. We can automate as `fleetctl carveout verify-root --job=<id>`.

oscar: metrics to watch: host.pcielatency.p95, host.pcie_stalls, tenant.preempt_count, scheduler.placement_latency.p50. Alert if pcie_stalls doesn't drop by at least 10% or placement_latency rises >200ms.

paul: rollback plan: flip feature flag `spread_root_complex=false`, purge discovery tags, and trigger rebalance for impacted carveouts.

kai: i'll run canary tonight 23:30 UTC. miranda take pager for first 2h, oscar backup. infra-bot create CHANGE and INV tickets please.

infra-bot: CHANGE-7112 created by kai - discovery canary scheduled 2026-03-26T23:30:00Z. INV-7120 created for inventory tagging.

miranda: noted. will follow up with small PR to scheduler to implement `--check-root` preflight and a unit test for spread logic.
